title: Beautiful but problems
text: Beautiful but problems. Couldn't wait for this orchid to arrive. It was packaged exceptionally well. The orchids are truly beautiful a realistic. till you turn the pot to the side.  It is flat as a board and the stems are not movable so no shaping can be done. Then I noticed the pot had a deep crack in it and was shipped that way.  Sadly I had to return it.
